events.title: Juninho signs for 미들즈브러 for the third time in a £6million move from 아틀레티코 마드리드 .
레스터 시티 move into their new 32,500-seat Walkers Stadium after 111 years at Filbert Street . They drew 1–1 in a friendly with 아틀레틱 빌바오 .
미들즈브러 sign 애스턴 빌라 midfielder George Boateng for £5million.

Players' Union chairman Gordon Taylor calls for the Football League , currently in a financial crisis following the collapse of ITV Digital , to combine with the 12 Scottish Premier League clubs to form an expanded Football League. There has recently been talk of 레인저스 and 셀틱 resigning from the Scottish Premier League to join Division One of the English league, and for several years it has frequently been suggested by various sources that the two clubs should join the Premier League .
리즈 유나이티드 sign 리버풀 midfielder Nick Barmby for £2.75million.
리버풀 sell defender Stephen Wright to 선덜랜드 for £3million.
The FA Premier League season begins. 웨스트브로미치 앨비언 's first top division game for 17 years ends in a 1–0 away defeat to 맨체스터 유나이티드 .
선덜랜드 sign 레스터 시티 midfielder Matt Piper for £3.5million.
Lee Hughes rejoins 웨스트브로미치 앨비언 for £2.5million after a year at 코번트리 시티 , and is joined for £2.25million by 트랜미어 로버스 midfielder Jason Koumas .
선덜랜드 sign striker Marcus Stewart from 입스위치 타운 for £3.25million.
레알 마드리드 signs 인테르 's World Cup winner Ronaldo with a transfer fee of €45 million.
